review.finding: `_SHARED_LIB = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "shared" / "scripts" / "lib"` is off by one: from `plugins/<plugin>/tests/` the repo root is `parents[3]`. `parents[4]` is the directory ABOVE the repo root, so the computed path does not exist and a bogus entry is inserted at sys.path[0] for the whole session. The import on the next line succeeds only by accident, because importing pr_review_model_policy already inserted the correct shared-lib path as a side effect.

The central security invariant of this diff — that the DEFAULT (DeepSeek) model actually delivers the ZDR provider body through main() to call_openrouter — has no end-to-end assertion. Only the negative arm (non-DeepSeek override returns {}) is pinned.
review.suggestion: Add a sibling test with the default model that runs main() through _wire and asserts the ZDR provider body reached call_openrouter.

review.finding: except (DeepSeekRoutingPolicyError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) misses UnicodeDecodeError (non-UTF-8 config file) and AttributeError (a config that parses to a valid non-object). Both escape as an unredacted traceback exiting 1 instead of the documented redacted EXIT_ERROR.
review.suggestion: Widen to except Exception, matching the two neighboring boundaries in main().

review.finding: Both fail-closed tests assert only that call_openrouter was never invoked, not that fetch_pr_diff/read_reviewed_head were also unreached (the stricter ordering the AC requires).
review.suggestion: Have _wire count fetch_pr_diff and read_reviewed_head invocations and assert both are 0 in the two fail-closed tests.

review.finding: `if fn is post_review_state_fn:` distinguishes the two posting failures by object identity, which becomes unreliable now that the posters are caller-supplied (a caller passing the same callable for both would misattribute a comment-post failure to the state).
review.suggestion: Carry the distinction explicitly in the loop tuple instead of identity comparison.

review.finding: Because DEFAULT_MODEL is now a DeepSeek identity, every main() orchestration test in test_pr_review_script.py and test_pr_review_stale_verdicts.py transitively runs the REAL resolve_extra_body against the real shared/config/external_review.json — an implicit, undocumented coupling unrelated to what those suites test.
review.suggestion: Stub resolve_extra_body to {} inside those _wire helpers so only the DeepSeek-specific modules own the config dependency.

disposition: All 6 findings fixed in this iterate — see the iterate spec's 'Code Review (spec-reviewer + code-reviewer)' section for the exact fix per finding. Full suite re-verified green (955 passed, 7 skipped) and ruff clean after the fixes.
